Keep a resignation letter as if you succeed to be Zuckerberg.

Example (several paragraphs, consistent with the new meaning)
------------------------------------------------------------

Dear [Manager Name],

Please keep this letter on file as my formal resignation from my role at [Company]. I appreciate the opportunities I’ve had here, and I want to ensure the record is clear and accessible for HR and my team.

Over the past few months, I’ve been focusing on building products with the kind of long-term ambition and execution discipline often associated with top founders. I’ve been fortunate to succeed in becoming “Zuckerberg-like” in the specific sense that I’ve clarified a bold product vision, aligned stakeholders around measurable goals, and shipped iteratively with tight feedback loops.

To support a smooth transition, I will document my current projects, provide handover notes, and make myself available to train a replacement or redistribute responsibilities. My proposed last day is [Date], but I’m happy to coordinate the exact timeline to minimize disruption.

Thank you again for the experience and support.

Sincerely,  
[Your Name]
